messages:
mina: Quick check: who owns cache eviction and coordinated rollouts across Hosted/Dedicated/Private?

rashid: Runtime should own local evictions. Control plane can request invalidations but cannot assume connectivity for Private.

clare: We need a minimal contract. Proposal: POST /v1/runtime/invalidate {tenant, model_id, prefix, seq, signed_nonce, blocking=false}.

rashid: Add monotonic seq per tenant and runtime stores last_applied_seq. Older seqs are ignored. Nonces prevent replay.

mina: For Private installs with no egress, provide an operator agent that applies signed invalidation bundles locally. Opt-in only.

deploy-bot: Branch feature/invalidate-contract created. Lint OK.

clare: Observability: emit invalidation_applied_seq and stale_cache_hit_rate per tenant. Also expose invalidation_source tag.

rashid: Edge case: model variant changes -> include model_id and optional rollout_id in payload so keys are precise.

mina: Operational playbook: hosted = control plane call; dedicated = routed call to tenant pool; private = operator agent or manual runtime API. Documented in Private install guide.

clare: I'll draft RFC addendum with API sample and agent CLI steps. Tests: seq monotonicity and agent delivery.

rashid: Sounds good. Ship RFC addendum by EOW. :thumbsup:
